CustomField.description: After a Contact merge, also merge the merged contact's household Account into the kept contact's household when other contacts remain in it (both record types must be listed in Automatically merge orphaned households). The remaining members, their records and the household's donations move to the kept household. Logged as an Account merge candidate with rule "Household Member Merge". See Max Other Members and Require Same Address for the safeguards.
